decision.observation: At 12:40 p.m. Friday, the farmer is midway along the fenced east–west road; the eastern route is clear and a northern dirt branch is visible.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east should reach Pelican Town with several hours remaining to find the southern beach route and Willy.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach; Fish Shop hours are 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. In town, turn south instead of continuing straight to the eastern riverbank. Late nights have reduced money.
